newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices ease despite buying by China.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices ease despite buying by China.

text.p: Thai rubber prices eased this week as supplies increased and despite buying from China, trade sources said on Friday.
Traders estimated Chinese buyers might have bought 10,000-20,000 tonnes of smoked sheet rubber this week for prompt shipment.
"That was not a big order. Besides, Japanese buyers are still sidelined,' one trader said.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for November shipment was quoted at around US$1.19-1.23 a kg FOB Bangkok, against $1.23-1.25 last week.
One trader said the C&F price to China was currently quoted around $1.30 a kg and the FOB price to Japan at around $1.21-1.22.
Thai latex was quoted at 95 cents a kg in the auction market in Hat Yai, barely changed from 93-95 cents last week.
Traders said the volume of rubber entering the market had increased from last week, pressuring prices.
Auction market sources said 371,392 kg of rubber sheets had entered the market this week, almost a five percent rise from last week.
